Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
How much experience do I need for a travel nursing contract?

Most facilities ask for one to two years of recent experience in the specialty you are applying for, and some high-acuity units ask for more. Your recruiter tells you up front which roles fit your background.

Can I work in a state where I am not licensed yet?

Often, yes. If you hold a compact license, many states are open to you right away. For the rest, we walk you through the application and the timeline before you commit to a start date.

Which certifications should I have ready?

BLS is required almost everywhere. ACLS, PALS, NRP or a specialty certification depends on the unit. Keep digital copies handy and we handle the rest of the file.
